items.title: The $25K/Month Dividend Blueprint: Exactly How Much You Need
items.summary: A retired couple with nearly $9 million in dividend stocks still had a tax problem. Chasing a bigger yield looks like the shortcut to $300,000 a year, but taxes, Medicare surcharges, and payout cuts can quietly erase the savings.

items.title: How to Turn a $1.04 Million Inherited IRA Into $4,290 a Month Before the 10-Year Rule Empties It
items.summary: A ten-year deadline forces you to drain your parent's IRA, and one wrong withdrawal schedule can push most of it into the top tax bracket. The smarter pacing, plus seven income holdings that each hide a catch, could decide how much you actually keep.

items.title: This Dividend Stock Could Turn a $100,000 Investment Into a $458 Paycheck Every Month
items.summary: Realty Income calls itself the Monthly Dividend Company; here's why retirees should find this boring stock very exciting.

items.title: Why Boomers Are Quietly Hoarding These Super-High-Yield Dividend Stocks for Retirement
items.summary: Five income stocks all beat the 10-year Treasury, but retirees who check the payout coverage may spot one with a looming deal that could change everything. Which dividend payer is hiding the biggest question mark?

items.title: 3 Monthly Dividend Payers Have December Checks Coming. The Cutoff for One Is Nov. 30
items.summary: Three monthly payers promise December income from rent, option premium, and a private-credit lender, but each has a different cutoff and one could cost you the check if you wait. Which deadline hits first, and which payout could shrink?

items.title: How to Collect Over $1,700 in Easy Passive Income From 3 High-Yield Leaders
items.summary: Retirees fear selling shares into a falling market just to pay the bills. Three high-yield stocks, one with a possible $34 billion deal looming, offer a way to keep every share and still get paid on schedule.

items.title: A 70-Year-Old With $750,000 in Edison International, Realty Income and Northwest Bancshares Collects $3,417 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Edison International, Realty Income and Northwest Bancshares pays about $41,000 a year in dividends, or $3,473 a month. Each company covered its dividend in fiscal 2025 on its own measure: Edison paid out 51% of normalized EPS, Realty Income 75% of AFFO and Northwest 63% of normalized EPS.

items.title: Your Bills Come Every Month. These 5 Dividend Stocks Pay That Way, Too
items.summary: Quarterly dividends leave retirees covering rent and utilities out of pocket. Five monthly payers promise to fix that, but one of them works differently from the rest, and each hides a risk that could shrink your check.
